xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5176: Test on the hosts users actually have: macOS CI and bare-host smoke (no tmux/docker/systemd), spawn budget, release gate

plan.title: Test on the hosts users actually have: macOS CI and bare-host smoke (no tmux/docker/systemd), spawn budget, release gate
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: PAN-5168, PAN-5169 and PAN-5170 made the operator's Mac unusable (an idle dashboard spawned 13-60 dead processes per second, pan up refused to start without tmux, and Linux-only systemctl/journalctl checks ran on macOS). None was caught, because every CI job runs on ubuntu-latest hosts with tmux, Docker and systemd. macOS appears only in the release desktop build, and no test starts Overdeck on a host missing an optional tool. Measured on v0.81.0 on a bare Mac: pan up failed on tmux/brew, and the idle dashboard created about 15 new PIDs per second.
narratives.Proposal: Add scripts/bare-host-smoke.sh (bash 3.2, env -i bare env without CI, a fixed six-entry PATH without docker/tmux/systemctl/journalctl/brew, Herdr from its vendor installer). It installs a tarball or npm version into an isolated HOME, asserts pan up --detach passes health without forbidden-tool text, measures the idle dashboard's net new PIDs per 30 s against per-OS budgets, scans logs for repeated spawn ENOENT, and writes result.json. Run it in ci.yml as bare-host-linux (every PR), bare-host-macos (path-filtered PRs and every main push) and a v0.81.0 known-bad canary that must fail for the expected reasons. Split release.yml so the exact core tarball is packed after sourcemaps and tests, smoked on macos-latest, and only then published. Add a spawn-ledger Vitest helper that patches the real node:child_process in vi.hoisted (mechanism probed during planning) and denies the host tools, plus three budget tests: PAN-5168 pollers on default deps, darwin with no systemctl/journalctl, and a Herdr conversation poll with 0 tmux calls. Document it in RELEASING.md, PIPELINE-GATES.md, TESTING.md, the codebase map and changelog.d. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-5176.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- The PAN-5171 drawer-title Playwright e2e: PAN-5171's own plan carries it (item e2e-drawer-title, PR #5177).
- GitHub branch protection or rulesets: main has none (gh api returned 404), and adding them is an operator setting.
- Adding bare-host checks to DEFAULT_MAIN_VERIFY_REQUIRED_CHECKS in src/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate.ts: that default applies to every project.
- Renaming or changing the build (22) check.
- A tmux-backend bare-host leg, or a Windows leg (windows-smoke.yml exists).
- Making the Mac rig a dependency of anything.
- Smoking @overdeck/contracts or @overdeck/desktop; only @overdeck/core goes through the macOS smoke.
- Runtime src/ changes, except same-class fixes of 20 lines or fewer that the smoke finds (D9).
- Raising an idle budget above 30 new PIDs per 30 s, or adding continue-on-error to bare-host-linux or bare-host-macos.
- Using coreutils timeout, or running the full npm test on the host.
- vi.mock of child_process in files that use the spawn ledger; skipIf, .only or .skip in new tests.

autoDecisions.summary: Leave the PAN-5171 drawer-title e2e (issue work item 7) to PAN-5171
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says to add it only if PAN-5171 has not; PAN-5171 is open with PR #5177 and its plan has item e2e-drawer-title, and PAN-5171 is not merged, so an e2e here would fail on main.

autoDecisions.summary: "Required check" means no continue-on-error plus Overdeck's any-failing-check merge gate; no branch protection change and no DEFAULT_MAIN_VERIFY_REQUIRED_CHECKS change
autoDecisions.rationale: main has no GitHub branch protection (404) and only the protect-overdeck-state ruleset; pr-facts.ts line 257 already fails the merge gate on any failing check; the dod-gate default is shared across projects.

autoDecisions.summary: Path-filter the macOS job with a job-level if over a dorny/paths-filter job, and widen the issue's path list with src/cli/**, bun.lock, the script and ci.yml
autoDecisions.rationale: A workflow-level paths filter would leave a required check missing; SKIPPED counts as passing. pan up lives in src/cli/index.ts, and the smoke must run when it or its own definition changes.

autoDecisions.summary: Run pan up with --detach and measure idle from a directly started server after pan down, following the reference script
autoDecisions.rationale: Without --detach pan up stays in the foreground; v0.81.0 exits before starting the dashboard, so the direct start is the only way to measure it; it also excludes sidecar noise.

autoDecisions.summary: Run every smoke child under env -i with a fixed variable list that omits CI
autoDecisions.rationale: ensureHerdr skips all Herdr setup when CI is set, and a real user host has no CI; OVERDECK_TELEMETRY=0 is passed explicitly (PAN-5084).

autoDecisions.summary: Fixed six-entry PATH per OS (real system dirs on macOS, symlink mirror minus denied tools on Linux)
autoDecisions.rationale: The macOS spawn storm scales with PATH entry count, so the measurement needs a stable count; Ubuntu runners have docker and systemctl in /usr/bin.

autoDecisions.summary: The smoke refuses to run when ports 3010, 3011, 3012 or 8317 are bound, and pkills only under the work dir
autoDecisions.rationale: stopDashboard kills whatever owns 3010/3011; on a developer host the smoke would otherwise kill the operator's live dashboard.

autoDecisions.summary: Net idle count = idle window minus a baseline window; per-OS budgets start at 30 and are calibrated to max(10, min(30, 3 x highest sample))
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says start at 1/s and set the figure from the measured post-fix rate; a baseline removes runner background noise; the rule is mechanical.

autoDecisions.summary: Add a v0.81.0 known-bad canary job that must fail for the tmux and rate reasons, run when the script changes
autoDecisions.rationale: It is the only way to satisfy the acceptance criterion "on v0.81.0 the macOS job fails" before merge (workflow_dispatch needs the workflow on main), and it keeps proving the smoke has teeth.

autoDecisions.summary: Release: pack the core tarball after sourcemaps and tests, smoke it on macOS, then publish that tarball; contracts and desktop publish as before
autoDecisions.rationale: posthog-cli inject rewrites dist, so the tarball must be packed after it; publishing the tested tarball is the "exact tarball" the issue requires; leaving contracts and desktop unchanged keeps the diff small.

autoDecisions.summary: Spawn ledger patches the real node:child_process in vi.hoisted with syncBuiltinESMExports, and denies host tools via a nonexistent-path redirect
autoDecisions.rationale: A planning probe showed this counts module-scope promisify(execFile), exec (once) and Effect spawns; vi.mock misses externalized Effect code; denying means a regression never runs the runner's real docker or tmux.

metadata.sizeJustification: 13 files, one issue the operator filed with joint acceptance criteria: the release gate, CI jobs and unit spawn budgets together make macOS regressions of the PAN-5168/5169/5170 class impossible to ship. The 9-subsystem count comes from directory spread (tests/helpers, tests/unit/helpers, tests/unit/spawn-budget, scripts, .github/workflows, docs, changelog.d, .overdeck/context), not from runtime breadth: no runtime src/ file changes. The work runs as two independent tracks inside one DAG (unit spawn budgets; smoke script -> CI -> release), so splitting adds issue overhead without adding parallelism.

narrative.Action: Implement PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-5176.md WI-1 exactly. Create tests/helpers/spawn-budget.ts exporting SpawnApi, SpawnRecord, DENIED_HOST_TOOLS, SpawnLedger, installSpawnLedger, spawnsPerTick and expectSpawnBudget, with the signatures in the PRD. Mechanism (D15, verified by probe during planning): createRequire(import.meta.url)('node:child_process'), wrap spawn, execFile, exec, spawnSync, execFileSync and execSync. Record only when a module depth counter is 0, so exec -> execFile counts once. Give execFile and exec their own util.promisify.custom wrapper that records and then calls the original custom function. Copying the original symbol bypasses the ledger, which the probe showed. Then call syncBuiltinESMExports(). Deny, do not pass through (D16): calls whose program basename is in deny are recorded and redirected to /nonexistent/overdeck-spawn-budget/<tool>, so real Node produces ENOENT. For exec, execSync and shell:true the program is the first word of the command string. restore() puts the originals back and calls syncBuiltinESMExports() again. The module header documents the vi.hoisted install rule, the no-vi.mock('child_process') rule and the afterAll restore. Write the self-test with cases (a)-(f) from the PRD. Add a 'Spawn budgets (PAN-5176)' subsection under '### Mocking' in docs/TESTING.md. spawnsPerTick must NOT catch tick rejections: a rejecting tick rejects spawnsPerTick (critique fix).

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-5 and FR-1..FR-11 exactly, starting from the reference check in the issue body. It must be bash 3.2 compatible (no associative arrays, mapfile, ${x,,}, wait -n) and use no timeout, gtimeout, realpath or readlink -f. Wall-clock caps use the reference limit() function. Use set -u, not set -e. Safety (D8): refuse with exit 2 when ports 3010, 3011, 3012 or 8317 have a listener on any address: lsof -nP -iTCP:<port> -sTCP:LISTEN -t (the pidsOnPort probe), then ss -ltnH when lsof is missing, plus a curl IPv4 check as a second check; fail closed with exit 2 when no probe tool runs (critique fix), and when --work-dir exists and is not empty. pkill only with patterns "$WORK_DIR/home/" and "$WORK_DIR/tools/". Delete nothing. PATH (D4): exactly six entries; on Darwin the system dirs as-is, on Linux $WORK_DIR/tools/sys/* mirror dirs of symlinks minus docker, tmux, systemctl, journalctl and brew. Verify that every denied tool is absent from the bare PATH. Children run under env -i with only the FR-4 variables, never CI, OVERDECK_HOME or OVERDECK_TERMINAL_BACKEND. Run pan up --no-resume --no-open --detach (D6); pan down plus the pkill backstop (FR-7); a baseline 30 s window; a direct server start with OVERDECK_NO_RESUME=1 and the pan-up port env; health poll, 20 s settle, idle 30 s window; net = idle - baseline against IDLE_BUDGET_MACOS / IDLE_BUDGET_LINUX (both 30 for now); the ENOENT repeat scan (FR-10). Write result.json with node -e, print a summary, append to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY when set. Exit 0, 1 or 2 as FR-11 says.

The script routes every child command through one bare() function that runs env -i with only HOME, PATH, USER, LOGNAME, SHELL, LANG, TMPDIR and OVERDECK_TELEMETRY=0 (plus the FR-4 dashboard variables for the server start), so a child never receives CI
